title: Unique Earthy Australian Mushroom Pie
description: A hearty and earthy pie filled with juicy Australian mushrooms, wrapped in crispy filo pastry and served in a stone bowl, perfect for a crowd-pleasing dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened
Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown
Stir in the thyme, salt, and pepper, and cook for an additional minute
In a large bowl, combine the cooked mushroom mixture and vegetable broth, and stir to combine
Unroll the filo pastry and cut it into 4 equal pieces
Spoon the mushroom mixture onto one half of each piece of filo pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges
Fold the other half of the filo pastry over the filling, and press the edges to seal
Place the pies in a stone bowl and brush the tops with a little bit of olive oil
Bake the pies in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown
